bodyweightSquat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweightSquat.cue: Sit back and down, knees tracking over your toes, heels on the floor.

gobletSquat.name: Goblet squat
gobletSquat.cue: Hold the weight at your chest and keep your back tall. Control the way down.

splitSquat.name: Split squat
splitSquat.cue: Feet staggered, drop straight down. Keep your front foot flat.

bulgarianSplitSquat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarianSplitSquat.cue: Rear foot on a sturdy chair. Check it cannot slide before you start.

inclinePushUp.name: Incline push-up
inclinePushUp.cue: Hands on a sturdy surface like a counter or a sofa. Body in one straight line.

kneePushUp.name: Knee push-up
kneePushUp.cue: Knees on the floor, body straight from knees to head. Lower with control.

pushUp.name: Push-up
pushUp.cue: Hands under your shoulders, body in one line. Go as low as you can control.

declinePushUp.name: Decline push-up
declinePushUp.cue: Feet on a sturdy step. Keep your core tight so your back does not sag.

closeGripPushUp.name: Close-grip push-up
closeGripPushUp.cue: Hands a little closer than usual, elbows pointing back. Drop to your knees if needed.

pikePushUp.name: Pike push-up
pikePushUp.cue: Hips high, head moves toward the floor between your hands. Go only as low as you control.

overheadPress.name: Overhead press
overheadPress.cue: Press straight up without leaning back. Ribs down, core tight.

floorPress.name: Floor press
floorPress.cue: Lying on your back, lower until your upper arms touch the floor. Press up smoothly.

oneArmRow.name: One-arm row
oneArmRow.cue: Support yourself with one hand, back flat. Pull the weight toward your hip.

bentOverRow.name: Bent-over row
bentOverRow.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back. Pull both weights toward your hips.

towelRow.name: Towel row
towelRow.cue: Loop a towel around a closed, sturdy door handle. Make sure it holds before you lean back.

bandRow.name: Band row
bandRow.cue: Sit tall with the loop band around your feet and hold it at both ends, or loop it around a sturdy fixed post. Pull to your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades. Sit closer or hold it looser for easier, further away for harder.

bandPullApart.name: Band pull-apart
bandPullApart.cue: Hold the loop band at both ends with straight arms and pull it apart to chest height. Hands closer together is easier, wider apart is harder. Keep your shoulders down.

proneYTRaise.name: Prone Y-T raise
proneYTRaise.cue: Lie face down and lift your arms into a Y, then a T. Light and slow. This is also the easier step if the band pull-apart is too hard.

romanianDeadlift.name: Romanian deadlift
romanianDeadlift.cue: Push your hips back with a flat back and soft knees. Weights stay close to your legs.

gluteBridge.name: Glute bridge
gluteBridge.cue: Feet flat, push your hips up until your body is in a line. Do not arch your lower back.

singleLegRdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
singleLegRdl.cue: Hinge on one leg, back flat. Hold on to something at first if you wobble.

reverseLunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverseLunge.cue: Step back and lower straight down. Keep your front heel on the floor.

bodyweightReverseLunge.name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
bodyweightReverseLunge.cue: Step back and lower straight down. Hold on to something if you need balance.

curl.name: Biceps curl
curl.cue: Keep your elbows by your sides. Lift and lower with control, no swinging.

towelCurl.name: Towel curl
towelCurl.cue: Pull a towel up with one hand while the other hand resists it. Keep both arms steady.

tricepsExtension.name: Triceps extension
tricepsExtension.cue: Elbows pointing forward, lower the weights behind your head slowly. Keep your ribs down.

plank.name: Plank
plank.cue: Elbows under your shoulders, body in one line. Stop when your form slips.

russianTwist.name: Russian twist
russianTwist.cue: Lean back slightly with a tall chest and turn from your ribs. Feet down if you are unsure.

deadBug.name: Dead bug
deadBug.cue: Lower back flat on the floor. Move opposite arm and leg slowly.
